overview: 本期共收录 8 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（7 篇）、银行与信贷（1 篇）。方法上以随机过程、数值模拟为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（5 篇）、Semantic Scholar（3 篇）。其中 1 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: The Role of Transparency in Repeated First-Price Auctions with Unknown Valuations
papers.abstract:
Abstract.
                  We study the problem of regret minimization for a single bidder in a sequence of first-price auctions where the bidder discovers the item’s value only if the auction is won. Our main contribution is a complete characterization, up to logarithmic factors, of the minimax regret in terms of the auction’s transparency, which controls the amount of information on competing bids disclosed by the auctioneer at the end of each auction. Our results hold under different assumptions (stochastic, adversarial, and their smoothed variants) on the environment generating the bidder’s valuations and competing bids. These minimax rates reveal how the interplay between transparency and the nature of the environment affects how fast one can learn to bid optimally in first-price auctions.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要：
我们研究了单个投标人在一系列首次拍卖中的遗憾最小化问题。在该情境下，投标者只有在赢得拍卖后才能知晓物品的价值。我们的主要贡献是对最小最大遗憾进行了完整的刻画，这种刻画精确到了对数因子级别，并将其与拍卖的透明度相关联；透明度决定了拍卖师在每次拍卖结束时披露的关于其他投标者的信息量。我们的研究结果在关于生成投标者估值和竞争性投标的环境的不同假设（随机性假设、对抗性假设及其平滑变体）下均成立。这些最小最大遗憾率揭示了透明度与环境性质之间的相互作用，以及这种相互作用如何影响投标者在首次拍卖中快速学习最优出价策略的能力。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Predictable Relative Forward Performance Processes: Multi-agent and Mean Field Games for Portfolio Management
papers.abstract:
Abstract.
                  We introduce predictable relative forward performance processes (PRFPP) as a new framework for studying portfolio management within a competitive and incomplete market environment. Each agent trades a distinct stock following a binomial distribution with probabilities for a positive return depending on the market regime characterized by a nontraded stochastic factor. For both the finite population and mean field games, we construct and analyse PRFPPs for initial data of the CARA class along with the associated equilibrium strategies. We find that relative performance concerns do not necessarily lead to more investment in the risky asset compared to when there are no such concerns. Under some parameter constellations, agents short a stock with positive expected excess return. The binomial market setting facilitates a straightforward adjustment of risky asset skewness, enabling an analysis of its impact on investment behavior—an aspect that continuous-time frameworks cannot capture.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要：
我们提出了“可预测的相对超额收益过程”（Predictable Relative Forward Performance Processes, PRFPP）这一新框架，用于研究竞争性且信息不完全的市场环境中的投资组合管理问题。每个代理人根据二项分布买卖特定股票，其获得正收益的概率取决于市场状况，而市场状况又受到一个不可交易的随机因素的影响。对于有限规模群体和平均场模型，我们针对CARA类初始数据构建并分析了PRFPP模型及其相应的均衡策略。研究发现，相对收益考量并不一定会导致投资者增加对风险资产的投资（与没有这种考量时相比）。在某些参数组合下，代理人会卖出预期超额收益为正的股票。二项市场模型能够直观地调整风险资产的偏度，从而便于分析其对投资行为的影响——这是连续时间框架无法实现的。。研究方法：随机过程、均衡模型。

papers.title: Which Cases Do Commercial Banks Fall Into After Adopting Artificial Intelligence? Evidence From the Asia‐Pacific
papers.abstract: From the perspective that returns and risks are inherently intertwined, this paper aims to examine the association between artificial intelligence (AI) adoption and return–risk outcomes for commercial banks. Using an unbalanced panel of 426 Asia‐Pacific commercial banks across 20 markets from 2015 to 2021, we find that banks adopting AI are initially associated with a best‐case return–risk configuration, characterized by an optimal scenario (higher profits coupled with lower risks). Over time, this configuration shifts toward a worst‐case scenario (lower profits and higher risks). Such return–risk effects are heterogeneous depending on bank size, IT governance and market development. These findings remain consistent across several robustness tests, including alternative measures, dynamics, model specifications and sample selection.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本文从“收益与风险本质上相互关联”的视角出发，旨在探讨人工智能（AI）的采用与商业银行收益-风险表现之间的关系。研究使用了2015至2021年间来自20个亚太市场的426家商业银行的数据，构建了一个非平衡面板模型。研究发现，初期采用AI的银行往往能够实现最佳的收益-风险组合，即较高的利润与较低的风险并存。然而随着时间的推移，这种组合逐渐转变为最糟糕的情况（利润降低、风险增加）。这种收益-风险效应因银行规模、信息技术治理水平以及市场发展程度的不同而存在差异。这些结论在经过多种稳健性测试后依然成立，包括使用不同的衡量指标、考虑动态变化、调整模型设定以及改变样本选择等方式。。

papers.title: THE IMPACT OF RURAL E-COMMERCE DEVELOPMENT IN NORTHERN ANHUI ON REGIONAL INNOVATION EFFICIENCY
papers.venue: Journal of Trends in Finance and Economics
papers.abstract: E-commerce assistance for agriculture provides new momentum for economic development and rural revitalization. Taking rural areas in northern Anhui as the research subject, this study investigates the impact of rural e-commerce on regional innovation efficiency. The findings indicate that the overall scale of rural e-commerce in northern Anhui has steadily grown, giving rise to distinctive products and brands, and establishing an innovative model involving multiple stakeholders. Patent applications and the number of high-tech enterprises in the region have shown a trend of steady growth with improved quality, accompanied by continuous increases in R&D investment and rapid growth in technology contract transaction volumes. Furthermore, the relationship between rural e-commerce and innovation efficiency reveals that e-commerce expands market opportunities and optimizes resource allocation, thereby stimulating innovation vitality, reducing innovation costs, and directly enhancing regional innovation efficiency. Additionally, through industrial agglomeration and attracting innovative talent, it indirectly promotes improvements in regional innovation efficiency. Based on these conclusions, relevant recommendations are proposed to support the strategic goal of rural revitalization in northern Anhui.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】电子商务对农业的扶持为经济发展和农村振兴提供了新的动力。以安徽省北部的农村地区为研究对象，本研究探讨了农村电子商务对区域创新效率的影响。研究结果表明，安徽省北部农村电子商务的整体规模持续增长，催生了具有特色的产品和品牌，并形成了一个涉及多方利益相关者的创新模式。该地区的专利申请数量和高科技企业数量呈稳步增长趋势，同时质量也得到了提升；研发投资不断增加，技术合同交易量也实现了快速增长。此外，农村电子商务与创新效率之间的关系表明，电子商务拓展了市场机会，优化了资源配置，从而激发了创新活力，降低了创新成本，并直接提升了区域创新效率。同时，通过产业集聚和吸引创新人才，电子商务还间接促进了区域创新效率的提高。基于这些结论，本研究提出了相关建议，以支持安徽省北部农村振兴的战略目标。。

papers.title: PriME: Privacy-Aware Membership Profile Estimation in Networks
papers.venue: SIAM Journal on Mathematics of Data Science
papers.abstract:
Abstract.
                  This paper presents a novel approach to estimating communbity membership probabilities for network vertices generated by the degree corrected mixed membership stochastic lock model [ 36 ] while preserving individual edge privacy. Operating within the [Formula: see text]-edge local differential privacy framework, we introduce an optimal private algorithm based on a symmetric edge flip mechanism and spectral clustering for accurate estimation of vertex community memberships. We conduct a comprehensive analysis of the estimation risk and establish the optimality of our procedure by providing matching lower bounds to the minimax risk under privacy constraints. To validate our approach, we demonstrate its performance through numerical simulations and its practical application to real-world data. This work represents a significant step forward in balancing accurate community membership estimation with stringent privacy preservation in network data analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
本文提出了一种新颖的方法，用于估计由度校正混合成员随机锁定模型[36]生成的网络顶点的社区成员概率，同时保护了单个边的隐私。在[公式：见正文]边局部差分隐私框架下，我们基于对称边翻转机制和谱聚类算法，开发了一种最优的隐私保护算法，以实现顶点社区成员的准确估计。我们对估计风险进行了全面分析，并通过提供与隐私约束下的极小极大风险相匹配的下界，证明了该算法的最优性。为了验证我们的方法，我们通过数值模拟展示了其性能，并将其应用于实际数据中。这项工作在网络数据分析中实现了准确社区成员估计与严格隐私保护之间的重要平衡。。研究方法：数值模拟、随机过程。

papers.title: Crank-Nicolson-type iterative decoupled algorithms for Biot’s consolidation model using total pressure
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  In this work, we propose and analyze Crank-Nicolson-type iterative decoupled algorithms for a three-field formulation of Biot’s consolidation model using total pressure. These algorithms are derived from an equivalent, reformulated fully coupled system based on the Crank-Nicolson method, which is then decomposed using an iterative decoupled strategy. Two variants are introduced, differing in the solving order of temporal computation and iteration: a time-stepping and a global-in-time approach. The latter is particularly notable for its potential for parallel-in-time computing, offering an efficient approach for long-time simulations. Capitalizing on the properties of the underlying methods, both algorithms are proven to achieve second-order accuracy in time and unconditional stability. Through numerical experiments, we validate theoretical predictions and demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of these novel approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
在本研究中，我们提出并分析了基于Crank-Nicolson方法的迭代解耦算法，用于求解采用总压力的Biot固结模型的三场问题。这些算法源自一个等效的、重新构建的完全耦合系统，该系统基于Crank-Nicolson方法构建，随后通过迭代解耦策略进行分解。我们介绍了两种变体算法，它们在时间计算和迭代的顺序上有所不同：一种是时间步进法，另一种是全局时间法。全局时间法在并行时间计算方面具有显著优势，为长时间模拟提供了一种高效的方法。利用所采用方法的特性，这两种算法均被证明能够实现二阶时间精度和无条件稳定性。通过数值实验，我们验证了理论预测，并证明了这些新方法的有效性和效率。。研究方法：数值模拟、实验方法。

papers.title: Tree-like pairwise interaction networks
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Modeling feature interactions in tabular data remains a key challenge in predictive modeling, for example, as used for insurance pricing. This paper proposes the tree-like pairwise interaction network (PIN), a novel neural network architecture that explicitly captures pairwise feature interactions through a shared feed-forward neural network architecture that mimics the structure of decision trees. PIN enables intrinsic interpretability by design, allowing for direct inspection of interaction effects. Moreover, it allows for efficient SHapley’s Additive exPlanation computations because it only involves pairwise interactions. We highlight connections between PIN and established models such as GA

Empirical results on the popular French motor insurance dataset show that PIN outperforms both traditional and modern neural network benchmarks in predictive accuracy, while also providing insight into how features interact with each another and how they contribute to the predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要

在表格数据中对特征交互作用进行建模仍然是预测建模中的一个关键挑战，例如在保险定价领域。本文提出了一种名为“树状成对交互网络”（Tree-like Pairwise Interaction Network，简称PIN）的新型神经网络架构，该架构通过共享的前馈神经网络结构明确捕捉成对特征交互作用，这种结构模仿了决策树的结构。PIN的设计本身就具备内在的可解释性，允许直接检验交互效应。此外，由于仅涉及成对交互作用，它还支持高效的Shapley加性解释（Shapley’s Additive Explanation）计算。本文还探讨了PIN与现有模型（如梯度提升机（Gradient Boosting Machines，简称GBM）和图神经网络（Graph Neural Networks，简称GNNs）之间的联系。在法国流行的机动车保险数据集上的实证结果表明，PIN在预测准确性方面优于传统的和现代的神经网络基准模型，同时还能揭示特征之间的交互方式以及它们对预测结果的贡献。。研究方法：神经网络、梯度提升。

papers.title: THE CONSTRUCTION OF PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENT SYSTEM FOR CENTRAL SOES' "AI+" INITIATIVES: A BALANCED SCORECARD PERSPECTIVE
papers.venue: Journal of Trends in Finance and Economics
papers.abstract: In 2024, the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC) of the State Council launched the "AI+" special action for central SOEs (state-owned enterprises), aiming to help them achieve better development and play a greater role in artificial intelligence. How to evaluate the performance of these initiatives scientifically has become an urgent issue for both theory and practice. Conventional performance evaluation systems, which rely primarily on financial indicators, may fail to capture the long-term value, intangible contributions, and national strategic significance of AI technologies. Drawing on Balanced Scorecard (BSC) theory and incorporating the three missions of central SOEs, namely sci-tech innovation, industrial control and security support, this study constructs a multidimensional performance evaluation indicator system for the "AI+" initiatives of central SOEs. "AI+"-specific indicators covering data assets, model efficacy, value creation, and other aspects are designed across the Financial, Customer, Internal Process, and Learning and Growth perspectives. The indicator system is then applied to a case study of CRRC Corporation Limited (CRRC), using publicly available data from its 2025 annual report and sustainability report, and an "AI+" strategy map is developed. The findings suggest that an adaptively modified BSC can effectively overcome the limitations of conventional financial indicators in evaluating AI outcomes, providing a scientific basis for SASAC's assessment and supervision and for the optimization of management in central SOEs.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】2024年，国务院国有资产监督管理委员会（SASAC）针对中央国有企业（SOEs）启动了“AI+”专项行动，旨在帮助这些企业实现更好的发展，并在人工智能领域发挥更大的作用。如何科学地评估这些举措的实施效果，已成为理论与实践亟待解决的问题。传统的绩效评估体系主要依赖财务指标，可能无法充分反映人工智能技术的长期价值、无形贡献及其对国家战略的重要性。本研究借鉴平衡计分卡（BSC）理论，并结合中央国有企业的三大核心使命——科技创新、产业控制与安全保障，构建了一个多维度的绩效评估指标体系，用于评估中央国有企业的“AI+”项目。该指标体系涵盖了数据资产、模型效能、价值创造等方面，从财务、客户、内部流程以及学习与成长四个维度进行设计。研究以中国铁路总公司（CRRC）为例，利用其2025年年度报告和可持续发展报告中的公开数据，构建了该公司的“AI+”战略地图。研究结果表明，经过适应性调整的平衡计分卡能够有效弥补传统财务指标在评估人工智能成果方面的局限性，为SASAC的监管工作以及中央国有企业的管理优化提供了科学依据。。研究方法：优化方法。
